ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alicon Castalloy Limited has announced a final dividend of Rs. 3 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26, with September 21, 2026, fixed as the record date for determining shareholder eligibility. This is a standard capital distribution that will result in a cash outflow for the company and a positive return for eligible shareholders. No material red flags are identified within this regulatory disclosure.
